prompt:
PLAN — THE LIFT
SHOTS L01–L03
DURATION: 15 SECONDS
FORMAT: HORIZONTAL 16:9

Create a three-shot cinematic scene showing Zahhak lifting both sisters off the ground simultaneously through one controlled movement of his serpent-headed staff.

Shot durations:
L01: 00:00–00:04.
L02: 00:04–00:10.
L03: 00:10–00:15.

The dramatic contrast is essential:
Zahhak remains grounded, composed and economical in movement.
The sisters experience the full physical force of his action.


CHARACTER REFERENCES

Zahhak: {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}

Preserve his exact sculptural mask, costume, proportions and established shoulder serpents.
His living serpents maintain subtle independent muscular movement whenever visible.
Each serpent has one head connected to one continuous elongated body.
Their bodies flex and slide naturally against his clothing.

Shahrnaz: {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}

Preserve her exact identity, sculptural mask, existing eye openings, hairstyle, costume and proportions.
Her natural eyes are visible behind the mask openings.
She holds her cat securely throughout the entire scene.

Arnavaz: {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}

Preserve her exact identity, sculptural mask, existing eye openings, hairstyle, costume and proportions.
Preserve the slightly lowered left shoulder and existing stone dust on her left garment.
Her hands are empty.

Both masks remain solid, rigid objects secured to the women’s heads.
When a head moves, its mask moves with it as one rigid unit.
Eye motion occurs only in the real eyes behind the fixed openings.
Preserve the exact shape of every mask edge and eye opening.


ANIMAL REFERENCE

Shahrnaz’s cat: {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

Preserve the referenced animal’s exact appearance and proportions.

Shahrnaz supports its body against her chest:
her left forearm supports its abdomen and hindquarters;
her right hand supports its chest.

The cat stays close to her torso and rises and descends with her.
Its ears draw back and its paws press against her garment.
Her protective grip remains supportive and secure.


PROP REFERENCE

Serpent-headed staff: {{PROP_STAFF}}

Preserve the exact referenced design, scale, material and carved head.

The carved serpent head is rigid and inanimate.
Zahhak holds the staff in his RIGHT hand throughout.
His left hand remains low beside his body.


LOCATION AND LIGHTING

A dark chamber whose architecture disappears into complete blackness.

Optional lighting reference:
[ASSIGN AN APPROVED DARK SPOTLIGHT FRAME HERE]

Character and prop references determine identity, costume and object design.
Their illumination is replaced by the lighting described here.

One fixed, hard, cold-neutral spotlight shines vertically down from above the group.

Its tightly controlled pool covers Zahhak, both sisters and a small patch of rough stone directly beneath the sisters’ feet.

The visible floor patch provides a clear height reference during levitation.
The surrounding floor and all architecture disappear into blackness.

Hard light catches upper mask planes, shoulders, hands, the cat’s fur, the staff and raised folds of clothing.
Lower surfaces fall into deep shadow.

The spotlight remains fixed throughout.
Its illuminated volume extends high enough to keep both women lit when they rise 1.2 meters.

Maintain the same light direction, intensity, color and exposure across all cuts.
Keep the surrounding black background completely dark.

The force is expressed through physical displacement, breathing, fabric tension and air movement.
The air remains visually clear.


FIXED BLOCKING AND SCREEN DIRECTION

Use one consistent side-view axis for all three shots.

Zahhak stands on SCREEN LEFT, facing SCREEN RIGHT toward the sisters.

Both sisters stand on SCREEN RIGHT, facing SCREEN LEFT toward Zahhak.

Shahrnaz occupies the nearer position, closer to the camera.
Arnavaz stands approximately 80 centimeters farther from the camera and 45 centimeters farther to SCREEN RIGHT.

This stagger separates their silhouettes:
Shahrnaz appears nearer the center-right.
Arnavaz appears deeper and farther right.
Both faces, torsos and pairs of feet remain individually readable.

Zahhak stands approximately 1.5 meters from Shahrnaz.
He directs the staff toward the midpoint between the sisters.

The sisters maintain their horizontal positions and spacing throughout.
They rise vertically above their own starting footprints and descend onto those same footprints.

All cameras remain on the same side of the action axis.
Zahhak stays screen left.
The sisters stay screen right.

Only these three people and the held cat occupy the scene.


SHOT L01 — THE GATHERING FORCE
00:00–00:04

40mm low three-quarter side view.
Camera height approximately 90 centimeters.
Frame Zahhak on the left and both sisters on the right, including their feet and generous space above their heads.

Zahhak faces right.
Both sisters face left toward him.
Shahrnaz is nearer the camera, holding the cat.
Arnavaz is farther back and slightly farther right.

Use restrained handheld movement with a stable, readable composition.

00:00–00:02:
Zahhak slowly raises his right forearm, bringing the staff’s carved head toward the women’s eye level.
His torso stays upright and grounded.
His shoulder serpents make small living adjustments.

00:02–00:04:
Both sisters’ breathing catches simultaneously.
Their chins lift slightly.
Their real eyes rotate upward behind their rigid mask openings.

Loose strands of hair begin lifting.
The free lower edges of their garments peel upward from gravity before their bodies move.

Shahrnaz draws the cat closer to her chest.
Arnavaz’s empty fingers spread involuntarily.

Both women’s feet remain on the stone until the cut.


SHOT L02 — THE LIFT
00:04–00:10

Cut to a wider 28mm low-angle view from the same side of the axis.
Camera height approximately 45 centimeters.

Keep Zahhak full-length on the left.
Keep both sisters full-length on the right.
Include the illuminated stone beneath them and enough headroom for the ascent.

00:04–00:05:
Zahhak gives the staff one short, decisive upward movement.

Both sisters rise simultaneously and rapidly, reaching a height of 1.2 meters above their starting footprints in approximately one second.

Their upper torsos lead the ascent.
Their legs trail beneath them with a slight physical delay.
Their feet leave the ground passively.
Knees remain loose and toes gradually point downward.

Their bodies remain anatomically continuous and retain their original proportions.

The handheld camera reacts with one brief physical jolt and a quick upward tilt, following the unexpected rise.
It immediately recovers a clear composition that includes the suspended feet and the ground below.

00:05–00:10:
Hold both sisters suspended at the same height.

Zahhak remains planted on the ground at lower screen left, staff raised.
The women occupy the higher right portion of the frame.

Their upper bodies arch slightly.
Their legs hang beneath them.
Small irregular tremors pass through shoulders, wrists and fingers.

Their torsos retain their original orientation toward Zahhak.
A circulating upward airflow catches loose fabric and hair:
garment panels ripple and curl around their legs;
hair streams upward and sideways in uneven waves.

The women’s bodies remain suspended in place while hair and clothing move around them.

Shahrnaz keeps both arms securely around the cat.
Arnavaz’s empty hands tremble beside her hips.

Allow restrained handheld instability while keeping the empty gap beneath both pairs of feet clearly visible.

Zahhak’s composure and the prolonged suspension carry the scale of his power.


SHOT L03 — THE DESCENT
00:10–00:15

Cut to a 35mm closer full-body composition from the same side of the axis.

Zahhak occupies the left foreground in rear three-quarter view, facing right.
His raised right hand and staff remain visible.

Both sisters occupy the middle distance on the right, facing left toward him.
Shahrnaz remains nearer the camera.
Arnavaz remains deeper and farther right.

Frame both suspended bodies, their feet and their landing positions.

00:10–00:13:
Zahhak lowers the staff with one slow, controlled movement.

Both women descend together, at the same speed, directly toward their original footprints.
The camera tilts downward with their descent in a restrained handheld movement.

Their toes meet the stone first, followed by the soles.
Their knees soften slightly as their weight returns.
Both settle into standing positions.

00:13–00:14:
The upward airflow stops.
Hair and loose clothing fall naturally under gravity.
The final fabric folds settle against their bodies.

Their tremors cease.
Their shoulders release.
Their breathing changes into one quiet, synchronized exhalation.

Shahrnaz continues supporting the cat against her chest.

00:14–00:15:
Both sisters slowly settle their natural gaze on Zahhak.
Their posture is now unnervingly calm.

Zahhak holds his position.
His living shoulder serpents continue their small independent movements.

Hold this final arrangement:
Zahhak grounded on the left;
both sisters standing on the right;
the cat still in Shahrnaz’s arms;
the staff lowered in Zahhak’s right hand.

Cut directly to black at exactly 15 seconds.


SOUND

L01:
Restrained breathing.
A soft tightening of Zahhak’s grip.
Cloth beginning to lift.
Two inhalations catching together.

L02:
A sudden rush of displaced air.
Garment panels snapping once during the ascent.
Sustained fabric flutter and strained breathing during suspension.

L03:
Air movement diminishing.
Soft contact of feet against stone.
Clothing settling.
One quiet shared exhalation.

Absolute silence at the cut to black.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_2>>> is Arnavaz (CHR-004 V01); match it wherever Arnavaz appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Shahrnaz (CHR-005 V01); match it wherever Shahrnaz appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Cat Persian Longhair (CRT-004 V01); match it wherever Cat Persian Longhair appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Dagger Horse Head (PRP-019 V02); match it wherever Dagger Horse Head appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Staff - Bronze Cobra (PRP-001 V01); match it wherever Staff - Bronze Cobra appears.
